CustomField.description: Whether this beneficiary has been released into an open reservation batch and may sign in. Set by ADHA_BatchReleaseJob, and only once the invitation SMS has actually been sent. Deliberately separate from Invitation_SMS_Status__c: that field is delivery reporting, and a provider receipt must never be able to change who can sign in. Only read while ADHA_Setting__mdt.Batch_Release_Mode__c is on and reservations are open; exploration browsing ignores it. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.startLogin or it reads as null.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the beneficiary has been texted their reservation slot. Untick only to withdraw access.
CustomField.label: Login Enabled
